title: x-mcp
description: Retired at generator 0.24.0 (X_MCP_RETIRED): nothing reads this block, and a spec declaring it gets one warning. Delete it. Tool exposure moves to the MCP manifest; safeForAutoInvoke moves to x-effects. See Arazzo Handbook §4.8.

exposed.description: Explicit opt-in for MCP tool exposure. Default: false

toolName.description: kebab-case tool name, globally unique across all scenarios in the repo. Required when exposed is true.

description.description: MCP-facing description of what the tool does. Required when exposed is true.

requiresActorAuth.description: Whether the tool requires actor authentication context. Default: true

safeForAutoInvoke.description: Whether an AI agent can invoke this without human confirmation. Default: false. Only mark true for read-only, low-risk scenarios.

exposed.description: Matches when exposed is true to enforce conditional requirements
